llm_response.reason: The website exhibits several classic fake shop scam indicators: it offers branded goods from Thursday Boot Company (a premium US brand) at suspiciously low prices well below the official market rate; the domain was registered only recently (June 2025), which is inconsistent with an established brand; all registrant information is hidden; the official brand does not publicly endorse this site nor operate localized Italian webstores; there are no direct social or official brand links, and public search/listings show no legitimacy or affiliation confirmation. These findings match scam criteria including characteristic #1 (unusually low prices), #4 (potentially non-existent or misrepresented company), and #16 (spoofs a legitimate brand), among others.
